newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares end lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares end lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Five stocks fell, one rose and four were flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday.
Turnover was at 1.9 million zlotys, down from Wednesday's 3.8 million zlotys.
NFI units fell 3.4 percent to 141 zlotys in a turnover of 9.4 million zlotys.
The continuous trading system, which lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks rose and the main market's index inched up 0.2 percent.
